original_question: Which companies led the most FL summaries under Agenda Item 7.1 (NR MIMO)? Top 5 (technical leadership).
original_query:
MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(ai:AgendaItem), (t)-[:MODERATED_BY]->(c:Company)
WHERE ai.agendaNumber STARTS WITH '7.1' AND t.summaryType = 'FL'
RETURN c.companyName, count(t) AS flCount ORDER BY flCount DESC, c.companyName LIMIT 5

evidence.finding: Meeting-qualified original agenda headings and eighteen corroborated own FL roles distinguish numeric Agenda7.1 from the NR-MIMO technology scope. The original numeric-only query has a reproducible top five.
evidence.counterauthority: The authored numeric-first wording and numeric-only query support a genuine operational interpretation if its technology descriptor is explicitly corrected. All eighteen numeric FL roles are source-corroborated; company attribution is not an unresolved blocker.
evidence.scope_limits: An explicit choice of numeric-first corrected descriptor, meeting-qualified technology scope or intersection is required. Five scope-sensitive documentary rankings are diagnostics rather than replacement gold.
